1.why: Text uses a clean sans-serif face at comfortable size with visibly loose line spacing in the body paragraphs and clear label/field separation.

2.why: No italics or all-caps appear anywhere, and all instructional text is a single short sentence rather than a dense block.

3.why: The layout is a single centred column with full-width fields and large tap targets which would reflow acceptably, but the screenshots are rendered at desktop width so mobile readability is not actually demonstrated.

4.why: Instructions such as 'Enter the six-digit code delivered to your verified mobile number.' are one short plain-language sentence each.

5.why: No placeholder, hint or sample value (e.g. '123 456') is shown for the email, phone or verification code fields; the fields are empty with only a label.

6.why: Every screen contains at most a heading plus one short sentence, so no long text must be read to proceed.

7.why: No copy button, selectable secret, or recovery-code display appears in any screenshot; the flow never reaches a stage where codes could be copied.

8.why: No QR code or any alternative to manual entry is present in any of the five screens; the authenticator setup step is never reached.

9.why: Fields have visible labels but there is no evidence of autocomplete attributes, autofill prompts, or password-manager affordances in the screenshots.

10.why: The section heading and blue primary button are prominent, but there is no step indicator (e.g. 'Step 2 of 4') so the current position in the flow is unclear.

11.why: Each screen requests a single action (sign in, then verify code), though the first screen combines two input fields under one Continue button.

12.why: A 'Logs' area reports 'Identity verification delivery was initiated.' but it is small, technical, and does not plainly state what comes next; the flow stalls with only an error.

13.why: The user can re-press 'Verify identity' to retry, but there is no resend/re-request link, no reveal/hide toggle, and no visible recovery-code controls.

14.why: The message 'We could not complete that request. Please try again.' does not blame the user but also fails to state the actual problem or how to fix it.

15.why: No countdown timer, expiry warning, or session limit is visible, but neither is any explicit statement of generous time, so the absence of limits can only be inferred.
